summary.headline: Hyleg of the Parents
summary.text: Rules for determining the Hyleg and Alcochoden in parental longevity judgments: Saturn, the Sun, the part and house of the fathers are considered in sequence, while Venus, the Moon, the part of the mothers, and the midheaven are examined for the mother according to diurnal or nocturnal birth.
